# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/gen_ek2_tab.py.
ucm_ek2_tab = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
}

ucm_ek2_max_arcana = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes }
	effect = {
		var:ucm_target = {
			# EK2 reads base_arcana_* only once at game start; afterwards the base lives in this variable.
			if = {
				limit = { arcana_base < 12 }
				set_variable = { name = arcana_base value = 12 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_trait = arcana_bad_1 } remove_trait = arcana_bad_1 }
			if = { limit = { has_trait = arcana_bad_2 } remove_trait = arcana_bad_2 }
			if = { limit = { has_trait = arcana_bad_3 } remove_trait = arcana_bad_3 }
			add_trait = arcana_good_3
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = magickal_education } } add_trait = magickal_education }
			add_trait_xp = { trait = magickal_education value = 100 }
		}
	}
}

}

	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { ucm_menu_target_valid_trigger = yes }
	effect = {
		var:ucm_target = {

		}
	}
}

			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_perk = conjuration_expert_perk } } add_perk = conjuration_expert_perk }

}
